categories.name: Release A
categories.description: Represents the standard discharge pathway for patients who stabilize after admission, contributing positively to avoiding post-discharge deterioration and measured against post-discharge ER return indicators.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative Release A (id=17) as observed in variants like V0008, V0551, and others without further subdivision.

categories.name: Release B
categories.description: Represents a distinct discharge variant path for admitted cases, contributing to avoiding post-discharge deterioration and tracked by post-discharge ER return indicators.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative Release B (id=18) based on occurrences in variants V0068 and V0145.

categories.name: Release C
categories.description: Represents an alternative discharge path for complex cases, supporting the avoidance of post-discharge deterioration and measured against post-discharge outcomes.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative Release C (id=19) as evidenced by long-running variant V0710.

categories.name: Release D
categories.description: Represents a specific discharge option for prolonged stays, contributing to avoiding post-discharge deterioration.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative Release D (id=20) as observed in variant V0273.

categories.name: Release E
categories.description: Represents an alternative final discharge disposition for captured cases.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative Release E (id=21) as defined in the goal model structure.
